definitions.explanation: Drinking alcohol to excess on a particular occasion. Implies going beyond a reasonable amount, often resulting in negative consequences the next day.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}は{深酒|ふかざけ}してしまった。
examples.english: I drank too much last night.

examples.japanese: {深酒|ふかざけ}のせいで{頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: I have a headache from drinking too much.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{早|はや}いから{深酒|ふかざけ}はやめておこう。
examples.english: I have an early morning tomorrow, so I'll avoid drinking too much.

notes:
Refers to excessive drinking on a specific occasion, not habitual alcoholism. For chronic heavy drinking, {大酒|おおざけ}{飲|の}み or アルコール{依存症|いぞんしょう} would be more appropriate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深酒|ふかざけ}する (to drink excessively)
- {深酒|ふかざけ}がたたる (to suffer the consequences of heavy drinking)
- {深酒|ふかざけ}を{控|ひか}える (to refrain from heavy drinking)

USAGE NOTE:
{深酒|ふかざけ} typically describes a single occasion of overdrinking rather than a pattern. It often appears in the context of regretting the next morning.
